title: Meta’s Muse aims to turn personal AI agents into a platform
teaser: Meta is turning Muse from a model initiative into a plan for personal AI agents embedded in its consumer platforms. The strategy matters because it joins advanced AI to an established business that already earns most of its revenue from advertising. If agents become a routine way to use digital services, Meta could gain a new interface for reaching users—and a new way to make its AI investments pay. But adoption is only part of the test: the company must also show that agents are useful, safe and economical to run.
